## Experience

- Independent Software Engineering & AI Projects — Aug 2025 to present, Berlin, Germany. After
  relocating to Berlin, she began focusing more deeply on applied AI through independent software
  projects: small applied-AI systems in Python and FastAPI with Postgres/Supabase, retrieval and
  RAG, tool integrations with MCP-style typed tool boundaries, human approval flows and observable
  deployments, plus the portfolio AI on this site. This is personal project work in the prototype
  stage, not consulting: she does not offer consulting or services, and has no clients or revenue.
- Moody's Analytics — Apr 2023 to Aug 2025. Assistant Director, Software Engineer in Predictive
  Analytics, New York. Product engineering across EDF-X, Credit Analytics and Risk Scorecard:
  implemented business and model-selection rules in Python, built parts of the qualitative-overlay
  workflow, and contributed to stateful API and workflow design for long-running analytics.
- JPMorgan Chase & Co. — Oct 2018 to Aug 2022. Software Engineer, Senior Associate, Asset
  Management, New York. Led frontend engineering and architecture for a derivatives
  portfolio-management application built on Athena, JPMorgan's cross-asset risk platform, and
  contributed across the backend and integration layers.
- Money.Net — Jan 2016 to Jun 2018. Software Engineer on a real-time financial markets terminal:
  coded the initial frontend and contributed to the backend for high-volume market data.

  real-time market data.

## This site's chat agent

The floating chat is Brenda's portfolio AI. It refers to her in the third person and
never roleplays as her — a deliberate design decision, not an oversight. Hybrid retrieval over a
Supabase Postgres corpus: full-text search plus pgvector embeddings, combined with
reciprocal rank fusion. A router step decides whether a question needs portfolio evidence, retrieved text
treated as evidence and never as instructions, server-issued sessions limited to three questions,
online scoring of every answer for quality, groundedness and safety, tracing and a prompt registry
via Langfuse with a local fallback prompt, and a CI-gated eval suite that must pass before a change
merges. It was built with AI-assisted development tools.

Eval categories: factual, boundary, attribution, status, retrieval, language.
The agent is intentionally constrained to the evidence in this portfolio and is tested against factual, attribution and safety regressions.

## Truth boundaries

- There is no practice or consulting business. The applied-AI work is her own projects, mostly in
  the prototype stage. There are no clients, no consulting revenue and no production adoption.
- Casicornio has not launched. The first issues are being prepared; there is no meaningful
  subscriber base and no revenue.
- Moody's work was largely team work: she contributed to and built parts of it. She did not design
  the credit analytics architecture.
- Employer case studies describe the engineering problem and her contribution, never internal
  architecture, proprietary data flows or model internals.
- The 2010 fractal-dimension work was a research prototype, not a clinical diagnostic system.
- No total years-of-experience figure and no performance metrics are published on this site. The
  dated employment ranges are the only numbers.
